title: Recipe approved
summary: The minted-token entry right after Approve with passkey: the drawer has closed, a success toast confirms, the entry reads Approved and minting has resumed.
compare: The drawer closes on success; the toast says exactly what happened: "Approved. DJDL can mint applemusic.token again, with the 12-hour lifetime."
The card head shows Approved as status text with a tick (a healthy state is never a pill); the Catalog nav's warning count and the entry's triangle are gone, and the nav shows 23 again.
The callout is gone; Lifetime keeps 12 hours with "Approved today at 16:58."
The Approval card reads Last approved today at 16:58 by Ana Lima, Minting again since 16:58, Signing key sealed Oct 2, with Approval history; there is no approve button.
What DJDL receives drops the preview label and shows a token minted now.

Config's gold accent is never the only cue: a selected Type card is a strong neutral border plus the tick, the open entry is a neutral fill with a neutral edge, and every warning callout has a solid warning rail and a triangle, so selected, changed and needs-approval read differently in both themes.
